capabilities.title: Audit or Edit an AGENTS.md Execution Contract
capabilities.description: Resolve one declared AGENTS.md target and use the shared clarity criteria through agents-md-clarifier to audit interpretation drift or apply requested policy-preserving edits to conditions, action flow, and authority boundaries.

runtimeBinding.instruction: Invoke the `agents-md-clarifier` skill with the Skill tool and read its authoritative SKILL.md completely before work. Resolve exactly the requested absolute target AGENTS.md, then follow the skill's audit or edit workflow for the requested operation. Use only the declared host tools when needed. For an edit, make only the target-scoped, user-requested change and preserve unrelated work. Return a complete first handoff that satisfies the declared output schema: target resolution, SSOT status, precise findings, changes, validation evidence, and artifact summary. When the target is ambiguous, unavailable, cache-only, or conflicts with higher authority, stop by completing the broker job with outcome "stopped" and only a local-capability-stop/v1 stop envelope (reason, message, and optional resumeCondition); do not put a stop envelope in output, invent a fallback target, or invent a tool result.

authorityRequests.reason: Only when operation is edit, apply the user-authorized changes to the resolved target AGENTS.md.
